## Quick context for agents

**LumiBase** is an Edge-native Headless CMS.

Stack: Hono.js (Cloudflare Workers + Docker) · PostgreSQL + Drizzle · Logto OIDC · Cloudflare KV/R2 · @lumibase/runtime abstraction

Key rules:
- IDs: NanoID or UUIDv7 (never auto-increment)
- Multi-tenancy: `site_id` on every domain table, every query scoped
- AI safety: dangerous skills gate through `ai_approvals` (HITL)
- Cache: tag-based invalidation (`CacheProvider.invalidateByTag`)

Key entry points:
- API: `GET/POST /api/v1/items/:collection`, `POST /api/v1/ai/chat`, `POST /api/v1/flows/:id/run`
- Services: `apps/cms/src/services/`
- Schema: `packages/database/src/schema/`
- AI Skills: `packages/ai-skills/src/skills.ts`
